outcome: Neonatal line (NNL) width in deciduous teeth
cohort: Children from a long-term, prospectively followed population cohort (tooth samples from 129 teeth)
finding: A prolonged duration of vaginal delivery was significantly associated with a narrower NNL, while no significant association was found between NNL width and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: NNL width was not significantly associated with mode of delivery.
